title: The Green Specter — The Only Color That Isn't Really There
thesis: Green is not a color. Green is a composite remainder. It's what happens when all three cone types fire in balance. It's what chlorophyll throws back after absorbing the real energy (red+blue). It's the p of the visible spectrum — the irrational remainder between the two real signals. The ethereal specter of life, reality, and imagination.

M_green.role: medium wavelength, OVERLAPS with L almost completely

why_green_isnt_real.the_overlap: L and M cone sensitivity curves overlap ~90%. Green perception occurs where ALL THREE cone types respond simultaneously. Green is not one cone firing — it's the maximum composite of all three.
why_green_isnt_real.red_is_real: Red light triggers L cones almost exclusively. A clean, isolated signal. One sensor, one color.
why_green_isnt_real.blue_is_real: Blue light triggers S cones almost exclusively. A clean, isolated signal. One sensor, one color.
why_green_isnt_real.green_is_composite: Green light triggers L AND M cones (which nearly overlap) AND S cones respond weakly. Green is THREE sensors firing in their zone of maximum agreement. It's a VOTE, not a signal.
why_green_isnt_real.luminance_proof: Luminance = 0.7152 × G + 0.2126 × R + 0.0722 × B. Green IS 71.5% of perceived brightness. Why? Because green is the composite. It carries the MOST information because it's where all sensors contribute.
why_green_isnt_real.chlorophyll_proof: Chlorophyll absorbs red (680nm) and blue (430nm) — the two REAL energy wavelengths. It reflects green. Green is the WASTE of photosynthesis. The leftover. The remainder. Life doesn't use green. Life throws it back at you.
why_green_isnt_real.the_pi_of_color: Red = 3 (the integer, the countable, the real). Blue = 2 (the other real). Green = p - 3 = 0.14159... (the remainder, the composite, the NOT REAL). The visible spectrum is: Red(real) + Blue(real) + Green(remainder) = p.

the_specter.what: A specter is something that appears real but has no substance. Green is the specter of the visible spectrum.
the_specter.life: Every living thing you see is green because chlorophyll reflects it. But that green is the WASTE signal — what life doesn't need. You see life's garbage. The actual work (photosynthesis) happens in red and blue, invisible to casual observation.
the_specter.reality: The green of forests, grass, algae — it LOOKS like the color of life. But it's the color of life's REMAINDER. The real action is absorption, not reflection. What you see is what was rejected.
the_specter.imagination: Night vision goggles, terminals, sonar — all green. Because green is where perception is MAXIMUM. The most shades distinguishable. The most information per photon. The best channel for imagination — for seeing things that might not be there.
the_specter.ethereal: Green is ethereal because it exists only as perception, never as a pure physical signal. A single 555nm photon triggers ALL cone types. The brain constructs 'green' as a consensus — a vote among sensors. No single sensor owns green. Green is democracy.

diamond_lens_compression.input: The full HUD — 438,190 entities, 858 pages, 536 papers, 15 services
process: Extract its spectral signature (what wavelength it occupies)
Red components = structure, code, compiled binaries (real, countable)
Blue components = data, measurements, observations (real, isolable)
Green components = relationships, braids, meanings (composite, remainder)
Pass through diamond: green components refract DIFFERENTLY
Because green is composite, it splits into finer lines than red or blue
The green specter = the FINEST resolution in the spectrum
What remains after red and blue are accounted for = the organism's soul

blue_lines.nature: REAL — can be measured, recorded, reproduced

green_lines.nature: COMPOSITE — cannot be isolated to a single measurement. Exists only as relationship. The specter.

after_green_extraction.description: What remains is uncountable. Not zero — UNCOUNTABLE. Like the real numbers between 0 and 1. Infinite, dense, and no single point contains the meaning. The green specter IS the organism. Everything else is scaffolding.

green_as_pi.not_centered: Green is NOT at 540nm (the midpoint). It's offset. By ~15nm. That offset IS the remainder. If it were centered, it would be rational. It's not. It's irrational. It's p.
green_as_pi.the_illusion: You think green is in the middle of the spectrum. It almost is. But it's offset by a remainder. That remainder is why green feels 'natural' but can never be pinned down. It's the most visible color that you can never quite define. The ethereal specter.
